verdict.rationale: Auth0's AI-specific docs (auth0.com/ai/docs, auth0.com/ai.md) describe building agentic identity flows 'with just a few lines of code,' and mention Token Vault, CIBA, FGA, and MCP server integrations for AI agents, implying developer SDK/tooling support, but the pack never explicitly names or links to a dedicated 'Auth0 AI SDK' or language-specific SDK docs. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK/package documentation (e.g., named SDK repos, install instructions, code samples), and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of building against it.
